messages:
Alex P: Heads-up — vendor says ORD-9071 was split at origin. Crate A cleared EU customs, Crate B is held for documentation mismatch. We received partial allocation of 40 units (H100). Need ETA for remaining 20 and options to expedite. cc Sofia (Supply)

Sofia (Supply): On it. Vendor (NexaSupply) confirms partial release. AWB for Crate A: 123-45678901. Container B flagged by broker as 'electronic goods — invoice HS-code vs packing list mismatch'. Carrier/BL: MSC 987654321. Broker quoted local clearance fee €1,200 to amend docs + fast release. Will get serial list in ~1h.

Ken (Infra): We can absorb 40 into eu-ams pool but will stagger deployments. Firmware baseline? Also need to ensure warranty/serial mapping for split shipments.

Maria (Ops): If we pay the broker fee, transit to our DC is ~2d. Sea re-export & consolidation would be ~10–14d. Want a quick cost vs time call? :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Sofia (Supply): Vendor also offered air-split for Container B: 10 units air at ~$6k/unit (door-to-door) — vendor markup clearly. They can also split by serial ranges so we can at least spin up one cluster.

Nick (Logistics): AWB 123-45678901 snapshot shows Container B 'Held — customs'. Broker contact: Hans <hans@eubroker.com>, ref CB-7721. I'll open broker ticket and request the exact doc discrepancy. If we supply corrected ECCN and invoice, hold may clear without fee.

Alex P: ECCN — check with security. Are these EAR99? If not, that'll change process. Also do we have PO terms covering broker/ad hoc fees? Otherwise vendor wants PO amendment.

DeliveryBot: Shipment update: ORD-9071/CrateA scanned @ EU-AMS 2025-05-20 08:12. ETA to DC 2025-05-22.

Sofia (Supply): Quick sample serials for Crate A: H100-1001, H100-1002, H100-1003, H100-1004, ... Full CSV will be DM'd. Vendor requests PO amendment to cover broker fee — need approval.

Ken (Infra): Approve if we can charge to the procurement contingency. I'll hold off deployments on the serial ranges for Container B — set gating flag.

Maria (Ops): Vote time — :thumbsup: = pay €1,200 broker fee (fast ~2d), :hourglass_flowing_sand: = wait ~10d sea. React below.

Alex P: Leaning pay. We have a demo next week and losing capacity hurts. Approve PO update once Finance signs off. Sofia, ask vendor to split invoices (Crate A unchanged, Crate B amended).

Sofia (Supply): Will do. Vendor asks to charge CC ending ••4321 for the broker fee; alternatively they can raise a credit note against PO ID ORD-9071.

Nick (Logistics): I'll confirm with carrier that paying broker fee + corrected invoice will not trigger re-inspection. Also will request 'release on receipt' on broker ticket.

Ken (Infra): I'll add deployment gate: set env flag "hold_container_B"=true and blacklist serials from auto-deploy until cleared.

Alex P: Thanks everyone. Sofia — post final PO amendment/invoice here when you have it. Moving ECCN check to DM with Security.

Sofia (Supply): Will post updates. Opening ticket with vendor now. ETA for vendor reply ~1–2h. :+1:

Nick (Logistics): Broker ticket opened CB-7721. Hans says if we supply corrected invoice and ECCN it's likely a same-day clearance. Will follow up.

Maria (Ops): Noted. I'll prep inventory tag process for the 40 units and hold labels for the others.

Alex P: Acknowledged. Keep updates here. :white_check_mark:
